summary: iTonic Holdings Ltd, a Beijing-based foreign private issuer formerly named Pheton Holdings, filed a Form 6-K on 2026-09-30 furnishing interim financial statements for the period ended 2026-06-30. The exhibit covers routine reporting items: balance sheet and equity data for Class A and Class B shares, related-party balances, a Beijing Rural Commercial Bank credit facility, supplier and customer concentration disclosures, and a subsequent-event equity issuance dated 2026-09-09. No transaction, tender, buyback, strategic review, or abrupt management change is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary semiannual report, not a special situation, and carries no deal terms or risk-arb angle.
